criteria.requirement: Leaders Africa accepts residents of all nations and territories on the African continent (the DRC is an African nation): citizens or permanent residents of an eligible country, refugees or asylum seekers there, or people who have lived there for at least five years.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: All nations and territories on/in the continent.

criteria.requirement: Must be living in the region for the duration of the programme.
criteria.applicant: Resident in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: You must be living in the region for the duration of the program and meet one of the following criteria:

criteria.requirement: Between 24 and 45 years of age on 1 September 2027.
criteria.missing: Exact age: the applicant must be at least 24 on 1 September 2027.
criteria.quote: You will be between 24 and 45 years of age on September 1, 2027.

criteria.requirement: At least 3 years of relevant experience in the applicant's issue area, and a leadership position in changemaking work (full-time or volunteer).
criteria.applicant: Three short internships and field assignments, under one year in total; no volunteer or changemaking role recorded.
criteria.missing: Volunteer, community or changemaking experience beyond the recorded internships: the programme asks for three years of relevant experience in an issue area.
criteria.quote: You can demonstrate at least 3 years of relevant experience in your issue area.

criteria.applicant: English is among the recorded languages; no proficiency level or test score is recorded.
criteria.missing: English proficiency level (no IELTS, TOEFL or similar score recorded).
criteria.quote: You are professionally proficient in English.

criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration, obtained in 2024; no degree is required.
criteria.quote: No, there is no education requirement for admission to the Obama Leaders program.

criteria.requirement: Applicants must be under no legal or regulatory restriction that would limit participation in virtual Foundation programming or travel to the U.S. for in-person programming (if any).
criteria.applicant: No such restriction is recorded in the profile.
criteria.missing: Whether any legal or regulatory restriction applies to the applicant (not recorded).
criteria.quote: you must be under no legal or regulatory restrictions that would limit your participation in virtual Foundation programming or travel to the U.S. for in-person programming (if any).

funding.conditions: Participants selected for the programme pay no fees.
funding.quote: Participants selected for the Obama Foundation Leaders program incur no fees.

funding.conditions: The programme is free to all participants.
funding.quote: The program is open across four regions and free to all participants.
Leaders will not be paid a stipend.

funding.conditions: No grants or financial support for participants' work.
funding.quote: The Obama Foundation does not offer grants or financial support for selected participants’ work.

out_of_pocket: No fees and no stipend. The programme is virtual, so no travel is stated; a computer with a camera and a reliable internet connection are the applicant's own.

cycles.window_text: Priority deadline 23 November 2026; applications after it are reviewed as space allows until 4 December 2026, 12:00 PM US Central Time (GMT-6).
cycles.quote: Applications open November 9, 2026, and close December 4, 2026, at 12:00 PM United States Central Time (GMT-6).
